name: Delta SkyMiles® Blue American Express Card

localized_names.en: Delta SkyMiles® Blue American Express Card

apr.notes: 19.49% to 28.49% variable APR on purchases, per the official American Express product page.

fx_fee.notes: American Express will not charge you foreign transaction fees when you use your Delta SkyMiles® Blue Card.

base_rate.description: 1X miles on all other eligible purchases. There's no limit to how much you can earn.

categories.label: Restaurants, including takeout and delivery in the U.S.
Delta purchases made directly with Delta

rewards.redemption_notes: SkyMiles program rules apply. Card Members can use Pay with Miles: take up to $50 off the cost of your flight for every 5,000 miles you redeem when you book on delta.com.

benefits.title: Pay with Miles
benefits.description: Take up to $50 off the cost of your flight for every 5,000 miles you redeem with Pay with Miles when you book on delta.com.

benefits.title: 20% Back on In-Flight Purchases
benefits.description: Receive a 20% savings in the form of a statement credit after you use your Card on eligible Delta in-flight purchases of food and beverages.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: American Express will not charge you foreign transaction fees when you use your Delta SkyMiles® Blue Card.

benefits.title: Amex Special Ticket Access
benefits.description: Card Members can access Amex Presale Tickets and Amex Reserved Tickets to select events across sports, music, and more.

benefits.title: Send & Split
benefits.description: With Send & Split, you can send money and split purchases with any other Venmo or PayPal user, directly from the Amex App. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of rental vehicle when reserving and paying with the Card and declining CDW. Coverage is not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand.

benefits.title: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services when traveling more than 100 miles from home, including medical and legal referrals, emergency cash wires, and missing luggage assistance.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Protects covered purchases against accidental damage or theft for up to 90 days from the Covered Purchase date.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Matches the Original Manufacturer's Warranty for up to one additional year. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less. Coverage limited to the actual amount charged on your Card up to $10,000 per item and $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.title: American Express Venue Collection
benefits.description: Enjoy an enhanced experience at select stadiums and arenas with on-site benefits including dedicated entrances or fast lanes. Enroll your Card and get 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases up to $250 per calendar year.

benefits.title: Dispute Resolution
benefits.description: If there is a fraudulent or incorrect charge on your statement, American Express will work with you to help resolve the issue.

benefits.title: Year-End Summary
benefits.description: The Online Year-End Summary, typically available in January, reflects charges posted to your account from January 1st through December 31st of the prior year.

other: Pay with Miles on eligible Delta flights
